packageRules.description: Digest-pin all docker images (tag + @sha256); renovate also opens pinDigest PRs for existing tag-only refs

Automerge patch/minor/digest updates once the PR's own CI checks pass (no branch protection on these repos, so this relies on internalChecksAsSuccess + platformAutomerge). Applies to docker images, runtime+dev Python deps, and mise pins. Majors stay manual — except GitHub Actions, see below
GitHub Actions: one PR per group, automerge ANY update (incl. majors) once CI passes
uv: mise.toml tool pin + ghcr uv builder image in the Dockerfile bump together
Remaining Docker base/compose images in one PR (uv and python excluded — they have their own groups)
Dev dependencies (pytest, ruff, ty, poe, semantic-release) in one PR
Runtime Python deps: individual PRs (they change the published image); patch/minor automerge via the global rule above, majors manual
python interpreter: docker python base image + mise python pin aligned in one PR (last — later rules win)
